DRAFT-ABRAITIS-BGP-VERSION-CAPABILITY-3-.note: Forbidden: no configuration option to enable or disable the capability. TestSoftverConfigOptionEnables asserts mode enable makes extractSoftverCapabilities declare code 75 (require.Len 1, Code 75); TestSoftverConfigOptionDisables asserts mode disable declares nothing (assert.Empty). Either goes red if the option does not control the advertisement.

Forbidden: the capability advertised when nothing configures it. TestSoftverDefaultsToDisabled asserts a peer with no software-version key gets no declaration (assert.Empty), red on an enabled default. Negative: TestSoftverDefaultIsNotABlanketRefusal, an explicit key declares code 75.

Forbidden: sending code 75 with Capability Length zero. TestSoftverCapabilityLengthIsGreaterThanZero asserts the value encodeValue produces is longer than zero (require.Greater), red on an empty value. Negative: decodeSoftwareVersion(nil) is refused. The unit also pins an inner length octet the draft does not define (see findings).

Forbidden: reading a zero-length Capability Value as a valid version. TestSoftverZeroValueIsAnEncodingError asserts decodeSoftwareVersion([]byte{}) returns ok false, red if it decodes. Negative: a well formed value decodes to zebgp.

Forbidden: acting on or displaying a zero-length capability. TestSoftverZeroValueCapabilityIsIgnored asserts RunCLIDecode of an empty value exits 1 with empty stdout, red if a version is shown. Its RunDecodeMode arm feeds value 00, which is Capability Length 1 with an inner length of zero, a neighbouring case. Negative: a well formed value is decoded and shown on both surfaces.

Forbidden: a Version field that is not UTF-8. TestSoftverVersionFieldIsUTF8 asserts utf8.Valid on the octets encodeValue writes after its length octet and equality with ZeVersion, red on invalid UTF-8 in the sent version. Negative: a non-UTF-8 value is refused by decodeSoftwareVersion. The unit skips the inner length octet the draft does not define (see findings).

Forbidden: interpreting invalid UTF-8 received in the Version field. TestSoftverInvalidUTF8IsNotInterpreted asserts decodeSoftwareVersion returns ok false and an empty string for FF FE FD FC, and RunCLIDecode exits 1 with empty stdout, red if the bytes are rendered. Negative: valid multi-byte UTF-8 decodes intact.

Forbidden: advertising or other nonessential information in the product identifier ze sends. TestSoftverProductIdentifierCarriesNothingNonessential asserts the sent identifier matches the product[/product-version] grammar with no spaces or prose (productIdentifierIsEssential), red if ZeVersion carried any. Negative: six identifiers carrying such information are refused by the same check.

DRAFT-ABRAITIS-BGP-VERSION-CAPABILITY-3..note: Forbidden: no RFC 9072 Extended Optional Parameters Length support. TestSoftwareVersionCapabilityUsesExtendedOptionalParameters packs an OPEN whose capabilities exceed 255 octets with code 75 inside and asserts the FF FF markers, the two-octet length, and UnpackOpen reporting ExtendedParams with identical parameters, red if either direction lacks the extended form. Negative: under 255 octets the classic form is used.

DRAFT-ABRAITIS-BGP-VERSION-CAPABILITY-4-.note: Forbidden: using a received Software Version Capability for anything but display, such as a session decision. TestSoftwareVersionCapabilityDecidesNothing asserts Negotiate yields the same ASN4, route refresh, extended message, enhanced route refresh, BFD strict mode, graceful restart, families and encoding with and without code 75, and no mismatch, red if the capability changed any of them. Positive: parseCapability keeps it as an Unknown with the raw value and PeerAdvertised records it.

Forbidden: advertising code 75 without explicit configuration. TestSoftverNotAdvertisedWithoutExplicitConfiguration asserts no declaration for a peer with no capability block, an empty capability block, and a group without the key (assert.Empty), red if any advertises. Positive: an explicit mode enable declares code 75 with encodeValue's payload.
